Entry Royal Audience An audience is a process of being allowed to enter the field of power: waiting, reporting, saluting, and speaking. Each step shows whose time is more valuable. The nobles compare seats outside the door, the common people wait for the decision outside the door, and the real master can use a delay to remind everyone to wait. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
